BiblicalUsage: Gur is a place in Palestine. In 2 Kings 9:27, the text says "Smite him also in the chariot. [And they did so] at the going up to Gur." It is a place, not a person, so there is no People profile for it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Gur matters because God's story happened in real places, and Gur is one of them.
